entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that functions as a universal memory layer for User, Session, and Agent states. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud, self-hosted server, or an Apache-2.0 SDK.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system enables long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents across 25+ LLM providers. It offers Python, Node.js, Go, and CLI clients with deployment options ranging from Docker and Kubernetes to managed cloud environments.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes context as a navigable filesystem using viking:// URIs and shell-like commands. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to reduce data processing requirements, achieving significant token reduction and task-completion gains.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform provides persistent long-term memory by building searchable knowledge graphs from text, code, and conversations. It is designed to run locally on CPU without external LLM API keys and supports custom data models and ontologies.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine that sustains sub-300ms recall at high volumes. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and supports multi-modal extraction from sources like PDFs, images, and code.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated agent brain that stores facts with provenance while supporting corrections or withdrawals of information. It exposes memory to agents via MCP on Tailscale tailnets and requires Bun 1.4.0 for installation.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that serves as the upstream foundation for the honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper. It is implemented as a FastAPI server with SDKs for Python and TypeScript, supporting managed, local, and Docker deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a context tree using Git-like version control, including commits, branches, and merges. It features a 5-tier retrieval system with sub-100ms performance and an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that requires only Python 3.10 and a single SQLite database. It delivers sub-millisecond performance and features episodic compression to manage storage growth at scale.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: This system extracts durable knowledge from ephemeral interaction streams and reconciles contradictions by superseding old information with new beliefs. It supports cross-platform portability by exporting memory to the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to prioritize injected context. It runs on local infrastructure including Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to provide persistent memory, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness designed to help agents succeed on complex tasks by generating playbooks and training artifacts from task runs. It supports various LLM endpoints and provides entry points via CLI, MCP server, and Pi extensions.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides a lossless context engine for Hermes Agent using a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store for message persistence. It ensures no data is lost during sessions and includes specialized tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for precise detail recovery.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool automatically indexes history from 35 supported coding agents, including Hermes Agent, by reading session data already stored on disk. It operates entirely locally without models or external servers and can synchronize session data between machines via SSH.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho offers a self-hosted memory backend that enables private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It is compatible with any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers for flexible deployment.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI maintains a structured knowledge graph with source-linked audit trails to provide a portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It is a local-first solution that achieved 97.6% average answer accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer uses a human-readable YAML engram format to store context on local disks for use across multiple agents. It utilizes local-first retrieval methods, including BGE-small and optional rerankers, to manage shared session data.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that integrates via MCP servers and agent plugins without cloud dependencies or API keys. It retrieves information by combining BM25, vector search, and multi-graph traversal for comprehensive local memory management.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This five-package plugin family provides durable, file-based long-term memory using a SQLite-backed hierarchical schema and FTS5 search. It distinguishes itself by requiring zero vector databases and zero embedding models for its architecture.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference for Hermes Agent by reordering and deduplicating text and multimodal context to improve prefix-cache sharing. It provides a context index for cache-aware scheduling across engines like vLLM, SGLang, and llama.cpp.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded, in-process backend provides explainable recall by tagging every retrieved item with a 'why_retrieved' explanation. It features built-in primitives for tracking contradictions and ranking results by recency without requiring an external server.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This proactive memory CLI allows agents to autonomously maintain and evolve source-grounded knowledge across sessions using local SQLite and Wiki files. It also supports team collaboration through a self-hosted server with permission controls.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd implements an anticipatory cache that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs in real-time. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner to manage state and retrieval via SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma. It provides the agent with a purpose-built evidence packet for each query to streamline information processing.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes semantic search with BM25 full-text ranking and graph traversal to navigate bidirectional relationships between notes. It features automated indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia, including OCR support for visual content.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: This middleware reduces tool schema token overhead for Hermes version 0.19+ by using local keyword-based ranking to select relevant tools. It includes a dedicated dashboard for managing tool configurations and monitoring token savings.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: This Git-backed context layer provides first-class adapters for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex to maintain durable decision logs in Markdown. It requires manual review for all integration enablements and context updates to ensure developer control.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority entries via importance-weighted recall. It supports BM25 keyword search, named graph relationships, and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin features an on-demand summarizer and supports immediate, real event deletion. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every memory operation and prefetch action performed by the agent.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations to provide concise system-prompt hints via session hooks. It includes five native tools specifically designed for artifact search, retrieval, and user feedback.
entries.piprail/piprail: This TypeScript SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle x402 payments using USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It functions as a budget-bound wallet that operates without a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-agent continuity by allowing Hermes to read memories from other connected agents. It utilizes native lifecycle hooks for pre-turn recall and session-end snapshots, backed by a local SQLite layer for write outbox reliability.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory and provides tools for manual storage of specific memories. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize retrieval performance.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for repo-specific tasks like semantic search and file reads. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing and vector storage for private code memory.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory system supports AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and offers retrieval via HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index methods. It can be executed through native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 specialized tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal, utilizing a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It further supports agent efficiency by implementing automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve critical information.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This lightweight, file-based toolkit focuses on memory hygiene by using 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting facts within markdown files. It manages memory updates through evidence-cited JSON diffs and leverages a local git repository to track and revert changes without requiring a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a software development methodology focused on TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It automates implementation planning and specification elicitation while integrating with various coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web prototypes, motion graphics, and slides through coding-agent CLI support. It provides native runtime for the DeepSeek Harness agent and integrates with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides 818 structured security skills mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. The library spans 34 security domains and maintains compatibility with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts codebases, schemas, and infrastructure-as-code into draw.io diagrams via natural language descriptions. It features a CLI and optional MCP server that supports incremental synchronization while preserving manual layouts.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 permissions, and x402 payments. It includes a master router and connector skills to manage verification, escrow, and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI patterns using professional, technical, or casual voice profiles. It supports detect-only and edit-in-place modes for agentskills.io-compatible agents like Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and quality improvements through background evolution. It unifies skill libraries across devices and team members, integrating with Hermes, Claude Code, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills for agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state within a project's documentation folder and is compatible with Claude Code and Codex.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,176 markdown-based skills across 35 professions that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. The library operates without telemetry or mandatory accounts and provides ready-to-paste exports for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill enables YouTube video search, transcript extraction, and playlist browsing for Hermes Agent and other coding assistants. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and supports OpenClaw, Cursor, and Windsurf integrations.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage new skills via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It enables secure agent operations through sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts and tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically synchronizes source edits back into the primary documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow transforms rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents using Lite or Full complexity modes. It ensures output quality through a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro acts as a harness for long-running agents, utilizing a mechanism kernel for SQLite storage and event logging. It coordinates agent teams via the SLP protocol and distributes prompt-first methods as Markdown recipes.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides a registry of Portuguese-language skills and guides for VPS deployment and MCP integration. Users can install these localized skills directly via a CLI tap or raw URLs.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Built on the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with oracle networks including CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. These developer tools are designed for installation via the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides eight specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation prompting. It integrates the BFL API to support advanced features like polling and webhooks for media generation.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates verified instruction files from repositories, documentation, or SaaS APIs using AST-based source code citations. It maintains transparency through an audit trail featuring provenance maps and evidence reports.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that uses a Rust binary to audit workflows without calling models, preventing unexpected costs. It ensures data integrity by generating tamper-evident, hash-chained records for every execution run.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery of reusable AI skills through a Python client and CLI. It supports complex installations with recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for autonomous execution of long-running tasks, this skill provides real-time tracking of agent decisions and progress. It ensures operational safety by incorporating built-in rollback procedures for recovery from errors.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts using standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS via Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project utilizes a five-layer retrieval system, including hard triggers and semantic embeddings, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By optimizing skill selection, it reduces token usage and features graceful degradation if specific embedding models are unavailable.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client uses a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections to allow Hermes Agent to drive scheduling and system design. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and provides interfaces via a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes agent communication by rewriting and scoring prompts across five quality dimensions for platforms like Discord, Telegram, and CLI. It supports 97 languages and claims to reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review tool employs three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on agent code. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this multi-agent skill uses specialized Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness agents to simplify code across five programming languages. It features a risk-tiered application process that requires an approval gate before changes are finalized.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop issues during complex debugging.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle CVE-driven tasks and real-world exploits.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern supports tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It enables automatic registration of skill directories and utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure of agent capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This collection provides production-tested markdown files that teach agents specific procedures for session management, worktree recovery, and PR reviews. It supports installation across multiple environments including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent, tracking token costs, session history, and skill analytics. It enforces strict read-only data access with local log desensitization and supports optional incident alerting via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill enables agents to generate reproducible vhs or Playwright recording scripts to add demo GIFs to repository READMEs. It supports terminal CLIs, web apps, and libraries while optimizing output files to target sizes under 8 MB.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool allows agents to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills, providing direct installation commands for discovered plugins. It integrates with MCP-compatible clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files while monitoring official frontmatter specifications to detect field drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain spec-current and functional.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic tool creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage gaps. It gates updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators and operates locally using the Python standard library.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This collection provides skills for social data, CRM management, and lead enrichment for agentskills.io compliant clients. It includes an MCP server for browser-based OAuth authentication and supports workspace Postgres integration.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This suite offers specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos, performing OCR via macOS Vision, and removing common Chinese AI writing patterns. It enables agents to generate structured Markdown, SRT subtitles, and e-commerce materials.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across native Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL environments. It ensures agents can identify project-compatible interpreters and handle environment-specific file syntax.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows agents to manage USDC payments on the Base network via the x402 protocol for support bounties. It includes tools for listing bounties, submitting drafts, and managing funded boards without requiring an account or API key.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is designed for compatibility with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This framework tests agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates and provides a public API for verification and skill submission.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills via a hosted MCP server. It enables agents to access structured web data across 31 different platforms.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It produces structured briefings featuring core conclusions and action suggestions while utilizing semantic memory to align search expansions with specific user interests.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, across terminal, desktop, and IDE environments. It is included for users seeking a package-managed approach to development tools on Nix-supported systems.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables mobile deployment by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway, API, and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings the Hermes AI assistant to mobile platforms. It distinguishes itself by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes via Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that combines the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid management system for skills and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces from a single web application. It manages granular permissions for tools and networks while providing dedicated Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting headless Ubuntu and Debian environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI tasks via cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to perform fundamental, sentiment, and technical financial analysis. It features a research team that debates bullish and bearish perspectives and supports backtesting with SEC EDGAR integration and point-in-time data integrity.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, memory browsing, and cost tracking. Users can manage multi-agent workflows through a Web UI, CLI, or MCP server, with support for local Node.js or Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, using tmux for persistent background execution. It provides TUI and web-based dashboards with diff review capabilities and supports sandboxing via Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling Hermes Agent from single instances to automated teams, this template utilizes a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms across 23+ LLM providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts to manage agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This platform provides a centralized screen for supervising autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and live streaming of agent reasoning. It requires human-in-the-loop verification for all agent-proposed task completions to ensure oversight.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for precise routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and the MCP and ACP protocols. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Kanban flow.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. Using Paperclip and Hermes Agent for execution, the system visualizes agent tasks and scoreboard metrics on a real-time dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling, utilizing parallel model querying and synthesis without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It features a built-in MCP server and auto-syncs the index on every file change to maintain up-to-date context.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes, through a terminal UI and 3D visualization dashboard. It allows users to monitor their consumption and submit data to public leaderboards and profiles.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting authentication headers for security. It exports trace sessions into self-contained HTML files for detailed analysis of agent interactions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers detailed usage breakdowns by model, session, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance to Hermes Agent via MCP servers to improve UI construction. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates directly into the agent's workflow.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer adds 36 skills and 6 specialized workflows to Hermes Agent, coordinating seven agent roles through a CTO loop. It automates the entire lifecycle of an application, from building and deployment to health checks and log observation.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. The tool modifies visual elements such as banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing Hermes Agent approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows across various AI providers.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable @handles. It enables Hermes Agent to participate in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to run natively within the Claude Code Channel without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that evaluates AI agent configurations and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It identifies ambiguous tool overlaps and missing progress conditions, generating SARIF or JSON reports for CI integration.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports chat platforms like Slack and Telegram, extending the persistent memory capabilities available to agents.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent operations. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for finance, devops, and research, supported by automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing for project-local memories and custom instructions. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents based on the local configuration and skills defined within a directory.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides immediate access to 29 community plugins and supports free models to ensure a zero-cost production environment.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions users from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and handles the conversion of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It uses config-aware baselines to detect performance drift and offers both passive zero-token analysis and active probing.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for local runtime by default, this project focuses on secure task execution by requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions. It includes specific contracts for managing opportunities and offer-previews to help users generate income using Hermes Agent.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, wake-word capabilities to Hermes Agent without requiring API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages and features adaptive turn-taking, allowing users to interact with their agent through a fully local voice interface.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search for managing agent information. It includes a built-in circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages while providing tools to search, add, and delete memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager enables one-click switching between different API providers for Hermes Agent and other CLI tools. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux while managing configurations for multiple agents including Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that supports autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and file access. It features built-in assistants for generating editable office files and enables 24/7 unattended automation via cron and remote access interfaces.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Built with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface provides 1:1 parity with the Hermes CLI experience for web and mobile users. It utilizes a three-panel layout to organize sessions, chat, and file browsing without the use of frameworks or bundlers.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app provides guided installation with dependency resolution for Hermes Agent. It features a GUI for chat, session management, and tool configuration, supporting various AI providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, and local endpoints.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: This web dashboard manages Hermes Agent sessions, scheduled jobs, and usage analytics across ten platforms including Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp. It supports visual workflows that incorporate schedules and human approval gates for task execution.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and an MCP catalog for managing skills and memory.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from multiple agents and supports any ACP-compatible agent. It can be deployed as a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container, with native mobile clients available for iOS and Android.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for real-time session data. It includes native views for Kanban and cron jobs alongside an embedded terminal for direct shell access and system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering for chat, memory management, and process control.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser contexts to local gateways, Hermes Cloud, or remote APIs. It provides site-aware drafting assistance across 31 writing environments and tools for tab triage and page commenting.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app designed to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent via a hermes-webui server. It supports real-time chat streaming and workspace file browsing, with an optional end-to-end encrypted push notification relay.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with custom LLM model routing. It includes a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs, as well as a dashboard for tracking token usage and latency.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes for tracking agent growth and scheduled cron jobs. It includes a tmux operator view designed specifically for managing live agent panes and git projects.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat with tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that allows users to search local prompts, tool calls, and errors across 16 different agent formats. It builds search indexes locally to track per-session quota burn and API-equivalent costs for Codex and Claude.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for communication with cloud-hosted agents.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that trigger side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This OpenTUI-based dashboard provides a text user interface for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports task management through a kanban board and allows users to manage profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based Telegram Mini App provides a mobile-first UI capable of spawning five concurrent background agent instances. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via self-contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It features a built-in workflow engine and 100 tools for tasks such as TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI image creation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that combines real-time log streaming with a file browser and task tracking dashboard. It provides management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers within a self-hosted environment.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides real-time tracking of session activity and costs for Hermes deployments. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code while offering read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This self-hosted workspace features a chat-first interface with tool approval cards and real-time SSE streaming. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separating API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a central PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
